summary: tslint-folder-schema preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated 727 KB payload
details: package.json declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs downloads a Bun runtime binary from a GitHub releases URL, extracts it to a temp directory, marks it executable, and invokes it via execFileSync to run the bundled `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a ~727 KB Bun-compiled bundle (`// @bun @bun-cjs`) with a shuffled string-array rotator (`WV8StW`) and single-letter mangled globals — classic string-array obfuscation, and not inspectable from the shipped source. The package's declared purpose is a small tslint rule (`lib/folderSchemaRule.js`), which never references setup.mjs or math_init.js; the install-time execution path is orthogonal to the advertised functionality. Routing execution through a freshly-downloaded alternate runtime that is not in the Node dependency graph causes the payload to run outside Node-oriented tooling at `npm install` time. The homepage points at `github.com/servicetitan/folder-lint`, but the install-time dropper and obfuscated Bun payload are unrelated to any tslint-rule behavior, consistent with a repurposed or typosquat delivery vehicle.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
